<!-- pr-reviewer: 1941469c786bc36ac9ab1f9346f453cff725731a -->
Ready for the maintainer to merge.

Docs/process only; nothing built (no code in the diff).

What looks good
- The `site` and `pages` jobs exist in `release.yml` on main. `pages` needs `site` and `publish` and runs only on a `refs/tags/` ref. `wasm` feeds `site`, and a failed wasm build falls back to the "not part of this copy" `/app/` page (`continue-on-error`, `app = false`). All of this matches the step's wording.
- The tag trigger is unchanged and no new `push`, `pull_request` or `schedule` trigger is added, so the Actions-minutes rule holds.
- "Re-run the red `pages` job, never move the tag" agrees with "Never move or re-push an existing tag".
- `PROCESS_VERSION` is 54, main's 53 + 1. The change touches AGENTS.md, so the bump is required.
- The decision file `docs/decisions/688-release-site-step.md` has the README format: a `## #N - title` heading, Decided, Why, Considered and dropped, Cost to change. The wording is plain.
- The PR merges cleanly with main, its head is up to date, and the body is complete (`Changelog: none`, ends `Fixes #688`).

Notes (not blocking)
- The decision file says v0.18.0's `pages` job failed until the maintainer re-ran it. I could not check that from the workflow, so the maintainer may want to confirm it.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.
